name: Data Story
tagline: Bars that grow, a hero number that counts up, and a source line you can trust.
description: Explainer style for metrics, reports and investor updates. A navy chart where bars grow in sequence and the insight bar glows teal, followed by a giant counting statistic with a one-sentence takeaway and its source.
textAnimations: value labels rise after their bar

rhythm.notes: Bars grow 0.12s apart; dim the non-insight bars to 45% once the last one lands.

guide:
- Look only: build the user's own subject in this visual language; don't reuse the example's scene.
- Deep navy #0b1730 ground; text #e8f1ff, labels #9fb4d6, axes and secondary text #6f86ad, hairline gridlines rgba(159,180,214,0.12). One highlight colour: teal #2ee6c5.
- One chart, one insight. Neutral bars #284066 with a 12px top radius; the insight bar is a #2ee6c5 → #1b9e8a gradient with a soft 40px teal glow. Dim the rest to 45% once the last bar lands.
- Bars grow from the baseline with scaleY 0→1, expo.out, 0.9s, 0.12s stagger; value labels rise 0.4s after their bar.
- Space Grotesk throughout, left margin 140px: a teal uppercase eyebrow (26px, tracking 0.18em) that slides in from the left, titles 700 at 76px (tracking -0.02em), labels 22–30px.
- Hero numbers: Space Grotesk 700, ~300px, tracking -0.05em, teal and centred. Scale in from 0.85 and count up with a proxy object + onUpdate writing Math.round(value) into the DOM, 1.6s power2.out.
- Every statistic gets a one-sentence plain-language takeaway (46px, centred) and a small muted source line (who, when, n=).
- Calm pacing, ~3.7s per scene; scenes leave with a fade-up exit (y -30, power2.in).
- Use real, specific numbers (e.g. 87%, 1,240) — never round placeholders like 100%. Avoid 3D charts, extra colours and decorative clip-art.
example: The preview shows review rounds per video falling across a week as bars, then a teal 87% counting up with its takeaway and source line. Don't copy this scene unless asked.
